constraints: Errors if vpAreaName does not designate an existing 4D View Pro area.
If name is already used within the same scope, the new named formula replaces the existing one; the same name can be reused across different scopes.
options.scope selects the sheet index (0-based) the name is local to, or the vk workbook constant to make it global to the whole document; vk current sheet scopes it to whichever sheet is current.
